entities.summary: Aki Mitsuhashi is a Japanese field hockey player born in Kurihara. At the 2012 Summer Olympics and 2016 Summer Olympics she competed with the Japan women's national field hockey team in the women's tournament. Aki Mitsuhashi was a athletes & competitors from Kurihara (b. 1989-09-12, Kurihara). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
